description: Prepare a Shopify checkout after the buyer confirms exact live variants and quantities. Pass checkout.cart_id and its cart_access_token to convert a cart, or checkout.line_items. Retain checkout_access_token from the response. Send the buyer to continue_url for review and payment; this does not place an order.

cart_access_token.description: Required when checkout.cart_id is supplied; use the owner token from create_cart.

cart_id.description: Optional Shopify Cart gid to convert/hand off into checkout.

meta.description: Optional UCP metadata. ucp-agent.profile is filled from server config when omitted.

name: create_checkout
title: Create Shopify Checkout MCP checkout
